title: Individual inverse-image open comparisons with units, restrictions and pasted mates
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S be cartesian, with derived module categories on all schemes [def-pc-derived-category], K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), and φ:Lg′K→K′. There is a family e(W):Rf′*Rj(g′⁻¹W)*r(g′⁻¹W)(K′)≅relativeMVLocalArrow(W).right [def-pc-relative-mv-maps, def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components]. For every open W it sends Rf′* of the exact-open unit to relativeMVUnit(pullback.fst g′ W.ι,f′,K′). For each inclusion W≤U it sends Rf′* of exact restriction to relativeMVRestriction along relativeMVOpenLift g′ i. For every W, mvBaseChangeOpenMap(W)≫e(W).hom equals Lg* of the explicitly constructed E(f,W,K).hom [lem-pc-relative-mv-exact-open-comparison] followed by relativeMVLocalArrow(W).hom. There are no biproducts, cover conditions, triangle boundaries or distinguishedness assertions in this statement.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-unbounded-mayer-vietoris), 08HZ (lemma-unbounded-relative-mayer-vietoris), 08HY (remark-base-change); perfect.tex, Tag 0DJ9 (lemma-single-complex-base-change), vertex identifications in the induction diagram

proof.text: Take the explicit family e(W)=relativeMVInverseOpenIso g′ f′ W K′. Its type is definitionally the right endpoint of relativeMVLocalArrow. Apply the proved unit and restriction identities from the construction node, pointwise in W and W≤U.

For each W apply the fixed-comparison mate identity. This gives the remaining clause for exactly the same family e; assemble the three universally quantified clauses with existential and conjunction introduction.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. These supply the object comparison and unit identity but do not compare exact nested restrictions or pasted scheme base-change maps.
Twelve hits: uniqueness, its unit and counit equations, and transitivity. No exact-open relative restriction or inverse-image-open mate identity.

Twenty-five msearch hits. Read Adjunction/Unique.lean, Limits/Preserves/Shapes/Biproducts.lean and AlgebraicGeometry/Restrict.lean. The scheme pullback-open iso and categorical assembly exist; no complete derived one-open comparison. Local rg over both library roots finds no duplicate.

theorem relativeMV_inverse_open_comparisons
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    ∃ e : ∀ W : X.Opens,
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
          ((schemeOpenRestriction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K')) ≅
        (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ W).right,
      (∀ W : X.Opens,
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map
            ((mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)).unit.app K') ≫ (e W).hom =
          relativeMVUnit (pullback.fst g' W.ι) f' K') ∧
      (∀ (W U : X.Opens) (i : W ≤ U),
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map
            (schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X'
              ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map g'.base).map (homOfLE i))
              (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ U))
              (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W)) K') ≫ (e W).hom =
          (e U).hom ≫ relativeMVRestriction (relativeMVOpenLift g' i)
            (pullback.fst g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' W.ι)
            (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) f' K') ∧
      (∀ W : X.Opens,
        mvBaseChangeOpenMap f f' g g' hpull.w K K' φ W ≫ (e W).hom =
          ((derivedPullback g).mapIso (relativeMVExactOpenIso f W K)).hom ≫
            (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ W).hom)
